observations: A large mouth occupies the center of the figure, framed by thick dark outlines; two rows of tall white teeth are separated by a black interior void, with a second, smaller set of lower teeth visible deeper inside.
Three bulging eye-like forms sit unevenly across the top of the figure, each containing a yellow-orange iris with dark hatched markings inside a rounded white surround.
Loose looping lines in teal, blue, and yellow scatter across the dark olive-brown body mass, which spreads low and wide with stubby limb-like extensions against a solid black background.
reading: The exposed teeth and dark void at center read as a shout or raw hunger—the mouth is the structural anchor, everything else radiating outward from it. Three staring eye-forms overhead create a sense of being watched from uneven angles. Scribbled colored lines across the heavy body sit restlessly against the dark mass, lending a charged, unsettled quality rather than stillness.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between #56 and #58 in both title and recorded-creation order. Its dark background and creature-body format contrast sharply with #56's blue-ground bird and #58's flat red-and-black silhouettes.

connections.reason: Both works place a face with visible white tooth rows against a black background and layer scattered multicolored scribble lines over a darker base form, creating a direct visual parallel across two different owned series.
